title: Annotatio VI §.VI (3): crucified for all → eaten by all — Acquisition≠Application
pass_a_gloss: But in the THIRD PLACE they urge: Christ’s Body was crucified and given for all, Therefore it is eaten by all, even the unworthy. Reply (1) Indirectly: Therefore also by Jews, Muslims, and Pagans? (2) Directly, distinguishing, on the common hypothesis, between Acquisition and Application: From the breadth of Acquisition made by Redemption to the same breadth of Application the Consequence does not hold.
pass_b_english: Third press: Christ’s body was given and crucified for all, therefore eaten by all, even the unworthy.
Indirectly: then also by Jews, Muslims, and pagans? Directly: Acquisition by redemption is not the same breadth as Application.
source_text: At verò TERTIO LOCO urgent: Corpus Christi crucifixum datumque pro omnibus esse, Ergo ab omnibus, etiam indignis, manducari. Resp. (1) Indirectè, Ergo etiam à Judæis, Mahumedanis & Ethnicis? (2) Directè, distinguendo, ex communi hypothesi, inter Acquisitionem & Applicationem: A latitudine Acquisitionis, per Redemtionem factæ, ad Applicationis eandem latitudinem, non valet Consequentia.
